evidence.quote: ### Acquired positive-field closed loops in a regular family

requires: Original periodic positive-field ferromagnetic Ising heat-bath model, one rate-one proposal clock PER SITE, theta=beta J fixed sufficiently large, phi=beta h=theta/R,R=J/h growing,n=L^2,CR<=L<=R^p. Source is allminus and actual target B={M>=0}; T_h=E_allminus tau_B. Retain acquired positive-field thermal core A=C_r,actual law pi_h(.|A),normalizer Z_A and source deficit D0 at their stated scope. Earlier core conditions theta>=4,1<=r<=R,r<L/4,contractible augmented plus components in r-by-r boxes and fixed zero-coupling contour diagonal are unchanged. Set w=exp(-beta H_h),physical conductance g(x,y)=w(x)c(x,y),C_kappa=kappa sum_A w(1-v),N_kappa=sum_(B^c)wv,Q_kappa=N_kappa/C_kappa;v is the decreasing probability that the core clock rings before B. New lobe/loop/open-graph constructions have their OWN additional geometric/temperature/field conditions, not an unrestricted theta4 closed-contour theorem.

The SPECIFIED regular family built from eight canonical rough arcs,broad macroscopic sectors and logarithmic physical junction words. Full sector/junction parameterization and detailed normalization construction are in the offered unacquired document; this is not every possible eight-arc loop or unrestricted principal contour.
provides: Acquire sampler for the UNMARKED ACTUAL POSITIVE-FIELD loop law and an acquired relative PHYSICAL normalizer in polynomial n,R,inputbits,accuracy inverse andlog(delta^-1),at the stated regular-family scope.

Canonical normalization uses connected-description truncation and Fourier coefficient extraction from the Dobrushin-Hryniv interval-cluster representation. Their complex analyticity/canonical local-limit controls are credited; algorithmic normalization/gluing are source constructions.

Actual thermal normalizer ratios restore microscopic junction interactions; an acquired finite-volume pressure correction restores positivefield. Broad sectors keep macroscopic width and rough-interface entropy. Coverage of all significant critical current remains UNPROVED. This positive restricted update supersedes any blanket reading of older units as saying NO closed-loop sampler has been acquired.

Evaluate the analytic certificate in polynomial work as reported, rather than forming an exponential current table or simulating long repairs. Retained SHARPER join is Q_kappa<=T_h<=(1+kappa D0)Q_kappa+D0 for EVERYkappa>0; older fractional (Q+D0)/(1-kappa D0) requires kappa D0<1 and is not the current prerequisite. Capacity expression retains its actual(n+kappa) term and all entropy subtractions.
